sports wagers that are authorized by law, Commission rule, Commission approval,
approved internal controls, and this catalog. Approval of a league or event does not
authorize any wager type that is prohibited by law, rule, Commission order, or a
Title 296, 13.003.01 authorizes the Commission to permit sports wagering on the
Title 296, 13.003.02 authorizes the Commission to permit the following wager types on
• Other types of wagers approved by the Commission
Unless otherwise specified, these wager markets are approved for the approved
event categories listed in this document.
• Event categories, events, and wager types not included on the Authorized Sports
Wagering Menu require Commission approval before being offered.
• The Commission may grant, deny, limit, restrict, condition, revoke, suspend, or
modify approval of any event category, event, or wager type for any cause the
• The Commission may prohibit the acceptance of wagers, order cancellation of
wagers, and require refunds where wagering would be contrary to the public
• Operators and Sports Wagering Services Providers may not accept wagers on
prohibited event categories, prohibited events, or prohibited wager types,
• Instate collegiate sporting events in which an instate collegiate or university team
• Individual athlete performance or nonperformance wagers involving a collegiate
sporting event in which a Nebraska collegiate team is participating.
• In-game wagers on a collegiate sporting event in which a Nebraska collegiate
• Individual athlete performance or nonperformance wagers involving an athlete
under 18 years of age participating in a professional or international sporting
event. This includes individual head-to-head events or markets where the wager
is determined by the performance or nonperformance of the under-18 athlete.
• Sporting events where the majority of athletes are under 18 years of age.
• Outcomes that have already been determined and are publicly known.
• High school sporting events or events below the high school level, regardless of
• Parimutuel wagers, except as otherwise authorized under applicable law.
• Any sporting event, event category, or wager type excluded by the Commission,
not authorized by law, or not authorized by Commission rule.
• The event can be effectively supervised by a sports governing body or other
• The outcome can be documented and verified.
• The outcome can be generated by a reliable and independent process.
• The outcome is not affected by any wager placed.
• The event and wager type are conducted in conformity with all applicable laws.
